cards.name: Return from Extinction
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return two target creature cards that share a creature type from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Dukhara Scavenger
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may put target artifact or creature card from your graveyard on top of your library.

cards.name: Fell Specter
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, target opponent discards a card.
Whenever an opponent discards a card, that player loses 2 life.

cards.name: Shrouded Lore
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent chooses a card in your graveyard. You may pay {B}. If you do, repeat this process except that opponent can't choose a card already chosen for Shrouded Lore. Then put the last chosen card into your hand.

cards.name: Oath of the Grey Host
cards.oracle_text:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You and target opponent each create a Food token.
II — Each opponent loses 3 life. Create a Treasure token.
III — Create three tapped 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.

cards.oracle_text:
Flying

cards.name: Lich's Caress
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. You gain 3 life.

cards.name: Rite of the Serpent
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target creature. If that creature had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 1/1 green Snake creature token.

cards.name: Reckless Spite
cards.oracle_text: Destroy two target nonblack creatures. You lose 5 life.

cards.name: Tourach's Canticle
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a card from it. That player discards that card, then discards a card at random.
